{{Top|leg}}
An '''Agreement of Aid''' was a document prepared by the [[Committee for Interinstitutional Assistance]] of the [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]]. It stated the agreed upon parameters of financial aid to be rendered to the approved, requesting parties regarding the establishment of annexations to the University.
